title: Nonclassical symmetries of polynomial equations and test problems with parameters for computer algebra systems
summary: Nonclassical symmetries and reductions of polynomial equations and systems of polynomial equations are considered. It is shown that specific polynomial equations having "hidden" symmetries can be reduced to classical symmetric systems of polynomial equations by introducing a new additional variable. It has been established that symmetric systems of polynomial equations of mixed type, consisting of symmetric and anti-symmetric polynomials, can be transformed into simpler systems.
